scope: Explicit building blocks and residual bookkeeping only. No complete inner/annular profile, correction iteration, smooth global forcing, or blowup proof is reproduced.

unchanged_local_archive.action: Leave untouched, do not use as input, and exclude from publication

unverified_obligations: Select all parameters in the paper's prescribed order with explicit valid bounds
Construct the nonlinear inner profile and match its five radial moments to the exterior
Establish the admissible stress cone and realize the required oscillatory waves
Verify residual-improvement estimates at every stage with derivative losses uniform in the stage
Control the infinite correction sum and every Cartesian space-time derivative of its residual
Complete localization, smooth forcing extension, and global uniqueness comparison
status_rule: Passing these checks can only produce building-block-audit-passed, never proof-verified or candidate-promoted. The earlier unforced .14 resolution failure is unchanged.
